Owners manage their club badges.name: Owners manage their club badges
Owners manage their club badges.using: exists (select 1 from public.clubs k where k.id = "club_badges"."club_id" and k.owner_id = (select auth.jwt() ->> 'sub'))
Owners manage their club badges.withCheck: exists (select 1 from public.clubs k where k.id = "club_badges"."club_id" and k.owner_id = (select auth.jwt() ->> 'sub'))
